latest_news: Registration for round 2 is available now.

Resignation for round 1 joined candidates will be available upto 06:00 pm of 09/11/2026. Freeze candidates need to visit the institute physically for withdrawal and float candidate can withdraw through online mode.
CHOICE FILLING FOR ROUND 2 PG COUNSLLING 2026 IS AVAILABLE NOW.
Pwd portal is open and available now for primary and appellate board assessment

Seat matrix for newly approved seats for round 2 of NEET PG counselling 2026 received from NMC on 3/11/2026. The seat matrix will be verified by the concerned institutes after application of reservation roster till 06/11/2026. Therefore round 2 counselling schedule will be rescheduled from 07/11/2026 onwards.

All participating institutes/colleges/hospitals are advised to verify the seat matrix carefully to ensure the correctness of the number of seats available in each PG course at their respective institutions. Any discrepancy observed in the seat matrix must be brought to the notice of MCC before the completion of the Round 1 choice-filling schedule for PG Counselling 2026.

The PwD portal for the Primary Assessment Board (Disability Centres) will remain available until 06:00 PM on 02 November 2026. The portal for the Appellate Board will be available from 29 October 2026 to 06:00 PM on 05 November 2026.
